points: \item Fine-tuned Llama-3.1-8B using QLoRA on domain-specific data with 4-bit quantization, gaining hands-on experience in parameter-efficient LLM training for production Gen AI applications.
\item Implemented a self-correcting RAG system using LangChain and Mistral 7B, improving answer reliability and mitigating context errors in document-level QA for enterprise chatbot workflows.
\item Built a multi-agent research workflow using CrewAI with retrieval integration via Model Context Protocol, enabling complex multi-step reasoning for information synthesis.
\item Developed an LLM-as-Judge evaluation pipeline to assess faithfulness and relevance across hundreds of QA examples, ensuring production-ready reliability for Gen AI products.
\item Introduced batched query extraction, reducing LLM API costs by ~80% per query and enabling faster, cost-effective production inference for chat applications.
\item Containerized and deployed Gen AI solutions using Docker and AWS Lambda, ensuring scalable production-ready pipelines for RAG systems and LLM-powered agents.
